chunks: If they do not answer you, then know that it has been revealed with the knowledge of God, and that there is no god but He. So will you submit?
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the source of revelation when disbelievers reject it?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the epistemological foundation of the Quran, affirming that its revelation stems from Allah's comprehensive knowledge rather than the Prophet's own intellect, thereby validating its divine origin. The concluding imperative 'فَهَلْ أَنْتُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ' (So will you not submit?) serves as a direct call to embrace Islam, often interpreted in light of the Ahl al-Bayt's role as the true guides of this submission. This reinforces the concept that true Islam requires not just verbal declaration but acceptance of divine authority as revealed through the Prophet and his progeny.
